$comment: Banned letter runs for the safe-letters filter (src/safe-letters.ts). Never spelled out: each run is a list of alphabet positions. `hebrew` runs are Old Letters positions (alef = 0 .. tav = 21, final forms folded, marks and spaces removed). `latin` runs are positions in the Latin alphabet (a = 0 .. z = 25) of the Choir-hand form: lowercase, i for j/y, u for v/w, c for k, letters only. Every run is matched forwards and reversed. `strictPairs` are only applied in strict mode (generated Names).

offensive.$comment: Offensive words, in the same encodings. Empty for now.
